title: Photonic Quantum Computing vs. Classical Solvers in Constrained Factor Portfolio Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.14134v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The authors present a rigorous empirical evaluation of three distinct optimization paradigms for institutional factor portfolio construction: an entropy-based photonic quantum annealer (Dirac-3, Quantum Computing Inc.), a commercial mixed-integer programming solver (Gurobi), and a model-free deep reinforcement learning agent (SAC). Evaluating these pipelines on the Jensen-Kelly-Pedersen 13-factor equity library across 164 months test window, we implement a full factorial penalty sweep comprising 48 hyperparameter configurations that govern return, volatility, and skewness trade-offs. Our findings demonstrate that while photonic hardware can locate superior risk-return topologies within a narrow operating range, classical mixed-integer programming remains superior for risk-constrained mandates requiring tight tail-risk control and cross-seed stability. translated_title: 光子量子计算与经典求解器在约束因子投资组合优化中的比较
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14134v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：作者对机构因子投资组合构建的三种不同优化范式进行了严格的实证评估：基于熵的光子量子退火器（Dirac-3，Quantum Computing Inc.）、商业混合整数规划求解器（Gurobi）以及无模型深度强化学习代理（SAC）。在Jensen-Kelly-Pedersen 13因子股票库上，跨越164个月的测试窗口，我们实施了一个全因子惩罚扫描，包含48个超参数配置，以控制收益、波动性和偏度之间的权衡。我们的研究结果表明，虽然光子硬件能在狭窄的操作范围内找到优越的风险-收益拓扑结构，但对于需要严格尾部风险控制和跨种子稳定性的风险约束任务，经典混合整数规划仍然更优。此外，我们记录了强化学习因子分配中的结构性失败模式。
tldr: 该论文通过实证比较发现，在约束因子投资组合优化中，经典混合整数规划求解器在风险控制和稳定性方面优于光子量子退火器和深度强化学习，而光子量子硬件仅在狭窄参数范围内展现优势。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically shows that classical mixed-integer programming outperforms photonic quantum annealing and deep reinforcement learning in constrained factor portfolio optimization for risk control and stability, with photonic hardware only showing advantages in a narrow parameter range.
